**Finding: deviation (medium) — no express performance/conformance warranty.**

- §5 contains only legality-of-performance, authority/rights and non-infringement representations (p0024–p0026), plus anti-bribery covenants — no warranty that the Services or Works will conform to the Specifications, no warranty period, and no remedy.
- §1(b) (p0005) supplies a professional-and-workmanlike performance covenant, but it is a covenant with no stated remedy, and §5(e) (p0030) disclaims all implied warranties including merchantability and fitness — so nothing backs conformance of deliverables.
- Redline validated (ok:true): new Paragraph 5(f) with a 12-month deliverable/software and 90-day services conformance warranty, no-malicious-code warranty, repair/replace/re-perform-or-refund remedy at Contractor's option, and an express carve-out from the 5(e) disclaimer. Fallback offered: 90 days / 30 days with the same remedies.
